question: Can a non-fitted, bounded and invertible density-domain Callier primitive preserve dye identity while exposing explicit metallic-silver illumination-geometry response without clipping or hidden RGB generation?

operator.input_domain: separate diffuse optical-density components: invariant dye density plus scattering metallic-silver density
operator.equation: D_directed = D_dye + D_silver * Q(D_silver, wavelength, collimation)
operator.q_family: Q = 1 + collimation * peak_q_increment * wavelength_weight * x * exp(1-x), x=D_silver/peak_diffuse_density
operator.parameter_origin: synthetic design values constrained by P6M qualitative observations; not fitted, digitized or calibrated
operator.ordinary_chromogenic_control: silver density is exactly zero, so dye-only output is exact identity

allowed_after_pass: retain the primitive as generic physical-inspired scanner/output-profile infrastructure
test one separately frozen qualitative chromaticity or photographic nuisance control without fitting this profile
compile the same explicit equation only after a separate performance and parity contract
forbidden: fit peak density, Q increment, wavelength weights or collimation on P6M figures or photographs
apply nonzero silver density to ordinary bleached and fixed chromogenic colour film
hard clip optical density or final RGB
describe the profile as a measured film, stock, process, projector or scanner response
merge the Callier stage with scanner flare, MTF, noise, creative bloom or AO6 colour
photographic promotion or production integration under this contract
relax any gate after observing results

branch_rule.pass: Retain generic primitive and freeze one independent value/compatibility leaf; no product promotion.
branch_rule.fail: Close this q-family without parameter rescue and continue another independent physical or colour leaf.

claim_ceiling: Generic physical-inspired metallic-silver illumination-geometry primitive with synthetic evidence only; not measured Callier response, stock/process/scanner calibration, photographic value or product promotion.
